stem.text: The graph shows the relationship between force acting on a compression spring and change in length of the spring.

stem.alt: Graph of force /N against change in length /mm on a grid. Vertical axis force /N from 0 to 180; horizontal axis change in length /mm from 0.0 to 10.0. A straight line passes through the origin.

stem.text: One of these springs is placed in each corner of a horizontal square plate. The axis of each spring is in a vertical direction. These four springs support a total load of $160\,\text{N}$.
